column1: # Venue registry: identifies venues for the counted-paper venue table (pipeline/build_venue_table.py).
# Identification only; no reputation judgment is encoded here (that comes later, separately).
# One row per venue. First matching row wins, so specific patterns come before general ones.
#   refereed  yes = peer-reviewed venue; no = preprint server, repository, technical report;
#   kind      conference | journal | workshop | thesis | preprint | report | book
#   name      canonical name used in the outputs
#   core      CORE2023 rank for conferences as published (data/raw/rankings/core2023.csv); recorded
#             as an external attribute only, blank if not ranked or not checked
#   dblp      comma-separated DBLP key streams (conf/x or journals/x)
#   regex     Python regex (case-insensitive) matched against venue strings from Crossref, OpenAlex,
#             zbMATH and ePrint "Publication info"; blank = DBLP only
